meta.title: DocuSwiss — Help with paperwork in Switzerland
meta.description: Understand your rights and prepare your administrative documents in Switzerland: debt collection, fines, rent, health insurance, work, taxes. In English, French, German and Ukrainian.

disclaimer: ⚠️ DocuSwiss provides general information and help preparing documents. We are not a law firm. For complex situations, please consult a licensed lawyer.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title:
Do you have
questions?
faq.a1: No. DocuSwiss provides general information and helps you prepare simple documents. We are not a law firm and do not give personalised legal advice. If your situation is complex, a lot of money is at stake, or court proceedings are already under way, please consult a licensed lawyer.
faq.a2: Information and basic templates are free. Later, we will offer an optional review of your document by a legal professional for a fixed price announced in advance.
faq.q3: In which cantons can I use the documents?
faq.a3: Our first documents are based on federal law (DEBA, CrimPC, CO, HIA), so they can be used throughout Switzerland. Only the addresses of the authorities differ by canton — we will tell you the right one.
faq.q4: What do you do with my data?
faq.a4: We only collect what is needed to prepare your document. The exact rules will be published in our privacy policy, in line with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP).
faq.q5: When will the documents be available?
faq.a5: The website is under construction. The first document — the objection to a payment order — will be published first, followed by the others one by one.
